vms.touch.keyboardHint: Opens the phone's keyboard; what you type goes to the VM.
vms.touch.fkeysHint: Shows the function keys F1 to F12
vms.touch.trackpadHint: Trackpad: a finger moves the pointer, a tap clicks, a two-finger tap is a right click, two fingers drag to scroll, tap and drag at once to drag with the button held.
vms.touch.directHint: Direct: a tap clicks where it lands, a two-finger tap is a right click, two fingers drag to scroll, a long press is a right click.
phone.edit.hint: Drag to move, onto another symbol for a folder, to the edge for the next page. A tap picks a symbol for the buttons here.
phone.edit.newPage: Drag here for a new page
phone.folder.label: Folder {name}, {count} programs
phone.folder.name: Name of the folder
phone.settings.title: Phone
phone.settings.dockHint: At the bottom of the phone's home screen, with programs of its own (press long to arrange). Off: its programs are on the pages.
phone.notices.swipeHint: Swipe left to delete a notification, right to mark it read. Pull down to load the list anew.
phone.files.shareReady: The file is loaded. Tap “Share” to hand it to another app.
phone.files.shareFailed: The file could not be shared.
phone.files.pdfFirstPage: The first page as a picture – zoom with two fingers. The whole document: open or download it.
